newsitem.title: RUSSIA: FORECAST-Russian MOF sees 1996 inflation 19-22 pct.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST-Russian MOF sees 1996 inflation 19-22 pct.

text.p: Russian 1996 annual inflation will amount to 19-22 percent, down from 131 percent in 1995, the finance ministry said on Friday.
Inflation in 1997 will slow to 10 percent or less, according to ministry forecasts.
The annual inflation rate will then slow to five-six percent from 1998 to 2001, it said.
Inflation has been falling steadily since the beginning of the year. In August consumer prices fell by -0.2 percent for the first time since the beginning of economic reforms in 1992.
The 1997 draft budget forecasts a 9.50 percent annual inflation rate.
